keyboardUnderside.scaleBasis: Existing 500 x 200 mm family keyboard envelope minus shell clearance; almost frontal image, residual perspective remains
keyboardUnderside.uncertainty: Allow several mm for envelope assumption and picked edges; height/depth inferred separately from oblique photos.

systemFeet.status: Owner confirms same part as keyboard feet; both instantiate identical rubber frame and metal insert modules.

materials.method: Visually estimated clean material colors and fine grain; no photo shadow, grime, wear or rust baked onto geometry. Not colorimetrically calibrated.

keycaps.status: Side profiles inferred from photos and 19.5 mm photo-fit pitch. Clear shell with silver liner and black legends confirmed by owner; local dimensions estimated.

keyboardLayout.pitchStatus: Photo fit within earlier ruler estimate 20 +/- 1 mm; not a caliper measurement
keyboardLayout.note: Full owner overhead photo gives key grouping, row stagger and paired half-pitch spacers. Residual perspective limits exact dimensions.

raisedWidths.source: Danila measured raised parts only, confirmed October 12, 2026
raisedWidths.note: Applied 18 mm to both Shift keys and the matching unlettered Caps shape; 23 mm to CTRL, ET and circled R. Caps/R classification follows owner photographs.

rearPanel.evidence: Separate pale keyed connector inserts and retaining blocks; three monitor power sleeves plus two unplated alignment holes; vertical mains inlet with slotted mounting screws; cross-slotted fuse caps; V24 alternating populated positions. Nameplate reads Typ W 1715/330, Masch.-Nr. 67581.
rearPanel.status: Local widths, recess depths, contact pitch and hidden contact geometry estimated; clean reconstruction excludes corrosion and wear.

reset.status: Nearly flush grey pad confirmed visually; dimensions and uncalibrated color are estimates.

monitorJoint.status: Photo-estimated clean joint; the inset dark retainer follows the tapered envelope. Exact gap and hidden fastening arrangement are unmeasured.

keyboardMarginReview.status: Photo-fit pitch and margins; raised wide-key sizes are owner measurements.
